verdict.rationale: Deel provides a well-documented public REST API (contracts, payroll, people) with a dedicated sandbox for testing, webhooks for events, and OAuth-based integrations, all confirmed by first-party docs and live probes (llms.txt, .md docs endpoints). This clearly supports AI-native/programmatic access beyond just MCP. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
